title: Inspection Calendar: Counter Card for the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
Every plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans requires the covered piece to be inspected at a set interval, logged on a channel the plan recognises. This card gives, per plan, the interval, the grace past a missed due date, the channels that count, whether coverage is suspended once the grace runs out, and the window inside which a logged inspection restores coverage without re-underwriting.

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Whole months between required inspections | 12 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 4 |
| Calendar days past the due date during which coverage is still treated as in force | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 | 60 |
| Channels an inspection may be logged on to count | home store | home store | home store; any Belrose store | home store; any Belrose store | home store; any Belrose store; authorised partner bench | home store; any Belrose store; authorised partner bench; in-home visit |
| Coverage suspended once the grace has run out | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Calendar days after suspension within which a logged inspection restores coverage without re-underwriting | 30 | 60 | 60 | 90 | 120 | 180 |

## Counter questions

**Where may a Belrose Care Plan 2-Year piece be inspected for it to count?** Only at the home store; an inspection logged at another Belrose store does not count on that plan, whereas on the Belrose Care Plan 3-Year and above any Belrose store counts.

**Which plan alone recognises an in-home visit?** The Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan, which is also the only plan on which coverage is not suspended when the inspection grace runs out, and the only plan inspected every 4 months rather than every 6 or 12.

**How long is the grace on a Belrose Care Plan 5-Year?** 45 calendar days past the due date, the same as on the 3-Year plan; the 2-Year plan and the Manufacturer Limited Warranty allow 30, and the two lifetime plans allow 60.
